description: ContributesTo across multiple source files and multiple inspect targets: each inspected stub is reported in inspect-array order (not sorted), a contributed sub-interface only directly extends its own source type, a successful compile with nothing to inspect prints just the status line, and an `internal` (non-public) interface is rejected.

sources:
package com.multi

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesTo

@ContributesTo(Unit::class)
interface Alpha
package com.multi

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesTo

@ContributesTo(Unit::class)
interface Beta

cases.expected_output:
status=compiled
contribution origin=com.multi.Alpha
extends com.multi.Alpha
contribution origin=com.multi.Beta
extends com.multi.Beta

package com.demo

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesTo

interface Parent

@ContributesTo(Unit::class)
interface Child : Parent

package com.demo

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesTo

@ContributesTo(Unit::class)
internal interface ComponentInterface

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=Contributed component interfaces must be public.
